tools.name: list_project_items
tools.description: Lists child items at a given project location in the Xojo IDE Navigator. Returns a tab-delimited list of item names. Pass an empty location to list top-level items.

location.description: Dot-separated project path (e.g. 'App' or 'Module1.Method1'). Leave empty for top-level items.

tools.name: get_current_location
tools.description: Returns the currently selected location in the Xojo IDE Navigator and its type (e.g. Class, Method, Window).

tools.name: select_project_item
tools.description: Selects and navigates to a specific item in the Xojo IDE Navigator. Use dot-separated paths like 'Module1.MyMethod'.

item_path.description: Dot-separated path to the project item to select (e.g. 'App', 'Module1.MyMethod').

tools.name: get_code
tools.description: Reads the source code at the current or specified location in the Xojo IDE. Navigate to the desired location first using select_project_item if needed.

location.description: Optional dot-separated path to navigate to before reading code. If empty, reads from current location.

tools.name: set_code
tools.description: Writes source code to the current or specified location in the Xojo IDE. This replaces the entire code content at that location.

location.description: Optional dot-separated path to navigate to before writing code. If empty, writes to current location.

tools.name: get_selected_text
tools.description: Returns the currently selected text in the Xojo IDE code editor, along with the selection start position and length.

tools.name: set_selected_text
tools.description: Replaces the currently selected text in the Xojo IDE code editor with new text. You can also set the selection position and length first.

selection_start.description: Optional character offset to set the selection start before replacing.

selection_length.description: Optional number of characters to select before replacing.

tools.name: build_project
tools.description: Builds the current Xojo project using the IDE's configured Build Settings. Returns build errors on failure, or a success message on success.

timeout.description: How long to wait for the build, in milliseconds. Default is 1800000 (30 minutes). 0 or a negative value means this default, not 'no limit'. If it takes longer, it carries on in the IDE and this request is left waiting for the answer: further requests are turned down until the IDE answers, and the MCP client must not be quit or restarted meanwhile - on macOS and Linux the IDE crashes if it answers after that. So set it generously.

tools.name: run_project
tools.description: Runs the current Xojo project in debug mode.

timeout.description: How long to wait for the debug build to compile and start, in milliseconds. Default is 1800000 (30 minutes). 0 or a negative value means this default, not 'no limit'. If it takes longer, it carries on in the IDE and this request is left waiting for the answer: further requests are turned down until the IDE answers, and the MCP client must not be quit or restarted meanwhile - on macOS and Linux the IDE crashes if it answers after that. So set it generously.

tools.name: stop_project
tools.description: Stops the currently running Xojo debug session.

tools.name: create_project_item
tools.description: Creates a new project item in the Xojo IDE. First navigates to the target location (if specified), then creates the item using a DoCommand.

item_type.description: The type of item to create. Valid values: NewClass, NewModule, NewMethod, NewProperty, NewConstant, NewEvent, NewNote, NewMenuHandler, NewComputedProperty, NewSharedMethod, NewSharedProperty, NewEnum, NewStructure, NewDelegate, NewInterface, NewWindow, NewContainerControl, NewFolder, AddEventImplementation.

parent_location.description: Optional dot-separated path to navigate to before creating the item (e.g. 'Module1').

tools.name: run_ide_script
tools.description: Executes an arbitrary Xojo IDE script. Use Print to return values. This is an escape hatch for any IDE scripting command not covered by other tools.

script.description: The IDE script code to execute. Use XojoScript syntax with IDE scripting commands. Use Print to return output values.

timeout.description: How long to wait for the script to answer, in milliseconds. Default is 10000 (10 seconds). 0 or a negative value means this default, not 'no limit'. If the script takes longer - or opens a dialog that waits for a click - it carries on in the IDE and this request is left waiting for the answer: further requests are turned down until the IDE answers, and the MCP client must not be quit or restarted meanwhile - on macOS and Linux the IDE crashes if it answers after that.

tools.name: get_project_info
tools.description: Returns information about the currently open Xojo project including the project path, Xojo IDE version, and selected item.

tools.name: get_item_description
tools.description: Gets or sets the description of the currently selected project item (method, property, event, etc.) in the Xojo IDE. Pass a value to set the description, or omit it to read the current description.

location.description: Optional dot-separated path to navigate to before reading/writing (e.g. 'App.MyMethod'). If empty, uses current location.

value.description: If provided, sets the description to this value. If omitted, returns the current description.

tools.name: constant_value
tools.description: Gets or sets the value of a project constant in the Xojo IDE. The constant must already exist in the project.

name.description: The fully-qualified constant name (e.g. 'App.kVersion'). A bare name (e.g. 'kVersion') silently fails in the Xojo IDE scripting API — always qualify with the containing module or class.

value.description: If provided, sets the constant to this value. If omitted, returns the current value.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Searches the local Xojo documentation guides and tutorials by keyword. Returns matching sections with surrounding context. Use this for conceptual questions about language features, patterns, and best practices. To look up a specific class, method, or property by name, use lookup_class instead.

query.description: The search term to look for (e.g. 'JSONItem', 'DesktopButton', 'FolderItem', 'database').

max_results.description: Maximum number of matching sections to return. Default is 5.

context_lines.description: Number of lines of context to include before and after each match. Default is 10.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Searches the user's personal Xojo notes, written and curated in the XDOX app. Notes capture the user's own conventions, hard-won fixes and project-specific knowledge — consult them when the user's own habits or prior decisions matter, as a complement to the official docs from search_docs. Notes flagged [possibly outdated] were written for an older Xojo version.

query.description: The search term to look for in note titles and bodies.

max_results.description: Maximum number of notes to return. Default is 5.

tools.name: lookup_class
tools.description: Looks up documentation for a Xojo class, control, data type or API. By default returns a summary: the page description plus its member tables with signatures. Pass member to get one member's full entry, or full=true for the entire raw reference (large).

class_name.description: The name of the class to look up (e.g. 'DesktopButton', 'JSONItem', 'FolderItem', 'String').

member.description: Optional property, method, event or constant name (e.g. 'Middle'). Returns only that member's entry.

full.description: Return the complete unabridged page instead of the summary. Default False.

tools.name: list_doc_topics
tools.description: Lists available Xojo documentation topics and pages. Returns an index of all documentation pages, optionally filtered by keyword. Use this to discover what documentation is available before looking up specific classes.

filter.description: Optional keyword to filter topics (e.g. 'Desktop', 'database', 'networking'). If empty, returns all topics.

tools.name: revert_project
tools.description: Reverts the current Xojo project to the version saved on disk. Use this after modifying project files (e.g. .xojo_window, .xojo_code) directly on disk to reload them in the IDE. The project is closed and reopened, so unsaved IDE changes are discarded and open editor tabs are lost. On Windows a throwaway project is briefly opened alongside it, because closing the last project window would quit the IDE.

tools.name: estimate_request_cost
tools.description: Estimates likely token cost for a proposed request and suggests cheaper alternative approaches.

request.description: Natural-language request to estimate (for example: 'Add a ListBox to Window1').

planned_tools.description: Optional comma-separated list of tools you expect to call (for example: 'select_project_item,create_project_item').

tools.name: get_debug_log
tools.description: Reads the XMCP debug log file (/tmp/xmcp_debug.log on macOS and Linux, %TEMP%\\xmcp_debug.log on Windows). This file is written by App.UnhandledException handlers in Xojo apps that use the XMCP debug pattern. Returns the file contents or an empty message if no log exists. Call this after a crash or unexpected app termination to retrieve exception details (message, error number, stack trace).

clear.description: If true, deletes the log file after reading it. Default is false.

tools.name: get_system_log
tools.description: Reads recent System.DebugLog output from the macOS unified log for a running Xojo debug app. The process name is the app name with '.debug' suffix (e.g. 'MyApp.debug'). Use this to retrieve diagnostic messages written with System.DebugLog() in the app's code.

process_name.description: The process name to filter by. For Xojo debug builds this is the app name with '.debug' suffix, e.g. 'MyApp.debug'. Use get_project_info to find the project name.

seconds.description: How many seconds back to search the log. Default is 60.

tools.name: save_project
tools.description: Saves the current Xojo project to disk. Call this after making changes via set_code or other IDE tools to persist them before building or running.

tools.name: analyze_project
tools.description: Analyzes the current Xojo project for compile errors and warnings without building. Reports unused variables, type mismatches, deprecated API usage, and other issues. Pass scope="item" to analyze only the currently selected item (faster); default is "project" to analyze everything.

scope.description: Scope to analyze: "project" (default) or "item" (currently selected item only).

timeout.description: How long to wait for the analysis, in milliseconds. Default is 300000 (5 minutes); a large project can need more. 0 or a negative value means this default, not 'no limit'. If it takes longer, it carries on in the IDE and this request is left waiting for the answer: further requests are turned down until the IDE answers, and the MCP client must not be quit or restarted meanwhile - on macOS and Linux the IDE crashes if it answers after that.

tools.name: debug_control
tools.description: Controls the Xojo debug session. Actions: "step_over" (execute current line), "step_into" (step into method call), "step_out" (step out of current method), "resume" (continue running), "pause" (pause execution). Requires an active debug session started with run_project.

tools.name: scaffold_code_block
tools.description: Generates a correctly formatted #tag block of Xojo project-file text (Method, Property, Constant, Event definition, Shared method, control event handler, or window event handler) for the caller to insert into a .xojo_code or .xojo_window file on disk. Use this instead of hand-writing #tag syntax from memory - it produces the exact Flags/keyword pairing and .xojo_window escaping documented in usage-guide.md's Format Rules block. This tool only generates text; it does not touch any file or the IDE.

block_kind.description: The kind of block to generate. Valid values: method, property, constant, event_definition, shared_method, control_event, window_event.

visibility.description: Visibility for method/property/shared_method: public, protected, or private. Ignored for other block_kind values. Default: public.

name.description: Method/property/constant/event name, or the control name for control_event.

event_or_signature.description: For control_event/window_event: the event signature, e.g. 'Pressed()' or 'Opening()'. For event_definition: the parameter list, e.g. '(newCount As Integer)'. Ignored otherwise.

constant_type.description: For block_kind = constant only: String, Integer, Double, Boolean, or Color.

default_value.description: For block_kind = constant only: the raw, unescaped default value. This tool escapes it automatically (quotes, commas, equals signs, apostrophes, non-ASCII bytes) — the same escaping applies whether the block is inserted into a .xojo_code or .xojo_window file.

target_file_type.description: The file this block will be inserted into: xojo_code or xojo_window. Informational only — Constant Default escaping is identical for both file types, confirmed empirically.

tools.name: lint_project_file
tools.description: Validates a .xojo_code or .xojo_window file on disk for known structural errors: wrong #tag block ordering, Flags/keyword mismatches, unclosed or mismatched #tag/#tag End pairs, and unescaped characters in constant Default values (both file types use the same escaping for commas/equals/apostrophes/non-ASCII; quote escaping differs slightly between the two — see usage-guide.md). Call this after editing a file directly on disk and before revert_project, as a safety net for mistakes scaffold_code_block does not cover (freehand edits, changes to existing blocks). Reports errors and warnings; does not modify the file.

path.description: Absolute path to the .xojo_code or .xojo_window file to validate.

tools.name: list_docsets
tools.description: Lists the Dash/Zeal .docset bundles registered via --docset-path, with their entry counts. Use this first to discover available docset names before calling search_docset or get_docset_entry.

tools.name: search_docset
tools.description: Searches registered Dash/Zeal .docset bundles by entry name (class, method, function, guide, etc.). Without docset_name, searches all registered docsets and groups results by docset. Use list_docsets to see available docset names.

query.description: The search term to look for (e.g. a class, method, or function name).

docset_name.description: Limit the search to a single registered docset by name (as returned by list_docsets). If omitted, all registered docsets are searched.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matching entries to return per docset. Default is 10.

tools.name: get_docset_entry
tools.description: Reads the full documentation content for a specific entry from a registered Dash/Zeal .docset bundle, as plain text. Use search_docset first to find the exact entry_name.

docset_name.description: The registered docset to read from (as returned by list_docsets).

entry_name.description: The exact entry name to read (as returned by search_docset).

--- Xojo 2026r3 Release Notes > Release_notes (part 18) ---
Compiler
--------

New Features

Android: Significantly reduced size of built Android apps by enabling shrinking and obfuscation. Default optimization allows Xojo introspection to work. Moderate optimization disables introspection on the Xojo framework. Aggressive optimization disables introspection on the Xojo framework and the user project. This should allow Xojo apps to pass the Play Store DEX optimization requirements going into effect in Feb 2027. (82039 <https://tracker.xojo.com/xojoinc/xojo/-/issues/82039>)

Resolved Issues

Updated Delegate.Invoke to treat weak-referenced instance methods that have gone out of scope as no-ops rather than raising a NilObjectException. This avoids an unhelpful exception which gives the debugger no meaningful code location to display. (81785 <https://documentation.xojo.com/resources/release_notes/confidential.html>)
Android: Fixed an Android compile error that could occur when using the Array function with some expressions. (81950 <https://documentation.xojo.com/resources/release_notes/confidential.html>)
Android: Fixed a compile error that could occur when subclassing a MobileScreen layout. (81926 <https://documentation.xojo.com/resources/release_notes/confidential.html>)
Android: Fixed some compiler errors that could occur when using Global with framework classes and with arrays. (81855 <https://documentation.xojo.com/resources/release_notes/confidential.html>)
Android: Multidimensional array properties are now initialized to the specified size. (81849 <https://documentation.xojo.com/resources/release_notes/confidential.html>)
Android: Fixed a compile error that would occur when instantiating a control subclass from code. (81887 <https://documentation.xojo.com/resources/release_notes/confidential.html>)
Android: Fixed a compile error that could occur with Delegate calls when the last parameter is a nullable type. (81327 <https://documentation.xojo.com/resources/release_notes/confidential.html>)
Android: Fixed an Android compile error that could occur when using AddressOf/WeakAddressOf with a method on a separate class instance. (81781 <https://documentation.xojo.com/resources/release_notes/confidential.html>)
